obligor_name: Covia Communities (separate obligor as of 2019-12-31; merged into Front Porch April 2021 / March 2022)
communities_2019: Spring Lake Village (Santa Rosa — note: Spring Lake was Front Porch, not Covia)
_communities_note: Covia (formerly Episcopal Senior Communities, renamed Covia 2018) operated 5-6 senior LPCs in Northern CA at 2019-12-31. Sub-segments: Covia Communities (LPCs), Covia Affordable Communities (HUD properties — separate), Covia Foundation.
_window_end_note: Covia ceased as separate obligor when merger consummated 2022-03-31; outcomes after that point roll to Front Porch.
_structural_note: Covia Communities was the LPC operating arm of the broader Covia organization (which also runs Covia Affordable Communities and Covia Foundation). Predecessor: Episcopal Senior Communities (renamed Covia in 2018). Rated A- standalone by Fitch in 2019-2020.

fitch.source: Covia maintains A- rating from Fitch (July 2019)
